outcome: Help first-time mobile shoppers understand their total and complete checkout without mandatory account creation.

evidence.claim: The hypothetical brief requires guest checkout.
The target includes 375 px mobile screens.
Show delivery cost before requesting payment details.
Supported payment methods and regions are not specified.

requirements.statement: A shopper can continue without creating an account.
acceptance_criteria: A signed-out shopper reaches confirmation without a mandatory password field.

requirements.statement: The primary path remains usable at 375 px.
acceptance_criteria: Controls do not overlap, clip, or require horizontal scrolling at 200% zoom.

requirements.statement: Cost changes are visible before payment confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Shipping, tax, discounts, and total changes are visible before confirmation.

decisions.choice: Keep account creation optional until after confirmation.
decisions.tradeoff: Collect less pre-purchase identity data in exchange for lower interruption.
decisions.verification: Complete checkout in a signed-out session.
